title_sq: Shitet shtepi me rrota e levizshme
description_sq: Shtepi e vogel, e dizenjuar dhe e ndertuar nga ne, per te qene masivisht e perdorshme, per investim si Airbnb dhe jovetem, Sezon vere prane detit, dhe ne sezon dimri prane malit. Keshtu maximizoni fitimin, pa nevoje per leje te mirefillte, thjesht nje vendqendrimi.
description_en: The small house, designed and built by us, to be massively usable, for investment as Airbnb and not only, Summer season by the sea, and in the winter season by the mountain. This is how you maximize profit, without the need for real permission, just a location.
